# OpenFamily

> OpenFamily is a self-hosted, privacy-first family location tracker (a Life360 alternative). You run the server. Family GPS locations never leave it.

Canonical site: https://foleyit.com/
Canonical repository: https://github.com/TheTractorHacker/openfamily

## What it is

- Self-hosted family GPS locator for a household (Life360-style live map, SOS, places, 90-day history)
- Flutter apps for Android and iOS talking to a Go API you host with Docker Compose
- Location, places, family roles, and history live in PostgreSQL + PostGIS + TimescaleDB on the operator's machine
- Android push via UnifiedPush / ntfy (no Google Play Services required); iOS push via APNs (payloads contain no coordinates)
- Maps are OpenStreetMap by default (no Google Maps SDK, no Google Places)

## What it is not

- Not NexaFlowFrance/OpenFamily (https://github.com/NexaFlowFrance/OpenFamily), a different product: a self-hosted family organizer for calendars, shopping, and chores
- Not a fleet, vehicle, or asset tracker (see Traccar)
- Not a commercial cloud family locator (Life360-class apps)
- Not OwnTracks (an MQTT location recorder) and not Dawarich (a personal timeline)

## Stack

- Docker Compose, Caddy (TLS), Go API (REST + WebSocket)
- PostgreSQL + PostGIS + TimescaleDB
- Flutter (Android / iOS), ntfy / UnifiedPush on Android, APNs on iOS
- OpenStreetMap maps; optional self-hosted raster tiles via TILE_URL
